|strategy=By [mailto:zube@eagle.cc.ukans.edu Nick Zube]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/tatooine/light/small/ajedispatience.html</ref>

Some Interrupts are just nice to have around &#150; like this one, for instance. Regardless of whether you fear duels or fear battle, [[A Jedi's Patience]] is just what the doctor ordered for a case of the jitters.

The first use of [[A Jedi's Patience]] is great battle insurance for players who like to deploy their characters fast for early control of the board. If your opponent ambushes one of your lightsaber-wielding characters, [[A Jedi's Patience]] can even the odds by giving you a +2 bonus to your total power in the battle. And, since this bonus is added to your total, it doesn't matter if your character escapes, dies, or otherwise leaves the battle before it's resolved.

As a Lost Interrupt, though, [[A Jedi's Patience]] is a perfect way to fake out your opponent in a duel. If you know you've got a high-destiny card waiting at the top of your deck, just lose this Interrupt to trade in your current duel destiny draw for a sleek replacement. With cards like this, who needs to track their destiny draws?

Don't like your duel destiny draws? Qui-Gon can re-draw both of them!
